_note: Monthly Money Wrapped (feature #63, SPEC v2.1 §21) — NEW ARB keys to merge into app/lib/l10n/app_en.arb and app/lib/l10n/app_bn.arb, then regenerate localizations (flutter gen-l10n, which the integrator runs — NOT done here). 53 message keys total. Placeholder metadata (@key blocks) is included for the 8 parameterized messages; the integrator inserts each @-block alongside its key in BOTH arb files (the bn values use Bangla script; bn placeholder @-blocks are identical to en and live only in app_en.arb by repo convention — keep them where the existing money @-blocks live). All amounts/dates are substituted at runtime via tkFmt/DateFormat in Dart; these strings contain NO currency numbers.
